dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

fillColorSteppedValues.description:
An array of values to which the property value is compared.

Example: [0, 10, 20, 30] => values 0-10 will be the first color in {@link #fillColorSteppedColors},
values > 30 will be the fourth color in {@link #fillColorSteppedColors}. This implies that the array lengths in
{@link #fillColorSteppedValues} and {@link #fillColorSteppedColors} must be the same.

fillColorSteppedColors.description:
The array of colors that will be matched with the corresponding values in
{@link #fillColorSteppedValues}.

title:
Color the node, edge or GeoJSON region based on a specified field's value in the data. The color of the item
will be assigned depending on where its field value falls among a set of "steps".
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyStepped
